title: The text model lineup changed quickly
summary:
The text API gained new model choices and more consistent JSON responses, while routing and queue behavior got less surprising.

DeepSeek-V3 arrived as `deepseek`, followed by `qwen-coder`, `mistral` and Llama 3.3 70B as `llama`. `llamalight` joined midweek but was removed by Friday; other older model listings were removed too. It was a week of changing the menu, not just adding to it.

`gpt-4o-mini-roblox` gained JSON-mode support, as did the new `qwen-coder`, `mistral` and `llama` integrations. Text generators now return full completion objects, with streaming, caching and response handling updated around that shape.

OpenRouter requests now use the model specified in the request rather than always selecting DeepSeek Chat. Requests exceeding the per-IP queue limit return a structured JSON 429 error, and OpenAI search responses can use up to 4,096 tokens.

The image queue wait changed from 500 ms per queued item to a fixed 500 ms. A small scheduling change with a practical effect when the queue gets busy.
